name: labs/freespace__pysmc100
title: Newport SMC100 single-axis motion controller
intro: Newport SMC100 single-axis motion controller, adapted from freespace/pysmc100. It reads `position`, `error_code` and `state`; runs `home`, `move_absolute` and `move_relative`. `home`: home the stage and leave it at the origin. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/freespace__pysmc100 --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/freespace__pysmc100 --backend fake --mcp
